title: Formulation Research Assistant (Evidence Scout)
short: An AI research assistant that gathers excipient-compatibility and pre-formulation evidence in hours, not weeks.
symptom: Pre-formulation literature takes weeks to review
ingredient: A literature scout for formulation scientists
directions: Enter the API and dosage form. Get a sourced summary of stability, compatibility and excipient evidence to review.
problem: Formulation teams spend weeks searching papers and monographs for API–excipient compatibility, degradation pathways and prior formulations.
why: Slow evidence gathering delays development, and missed incompatibilities surface late as stability failures.
solution: A retrieval assistant that searches approved sources, extracts compatibility and stability findings into a structured table, and links every finding to its source for the scientist to verify.
limitations: Only as complete as the sources it can access
Summaries must be verified against the original papers
review: A formulation scientist verifies every extracted finding against its source before it is used in a development decision.
